It is politically unacceptable that this report , which contains incorrect facts , was voted in Plenary today ( 24 November 2009 ) . We have tried to get this incomplete and therefore incorrect report taken from the agenda , unfortunately without success . This kind of proceeding by the European Parliament creates the impression of supporting the persecution of politically active persons , in this case , the Munich II Public Prosecution Service against a former Member of the European Parliament . The central point is that the report cites a judgment at first instance which has been repealed . in writing . - On 9 November 2009 , the report on the request for the defence of the immunity and privileges of Tobias Pflüger was voted and adopted in the Committee on Legal Affairs ( JURI ) in the European Parliament . This report is based on incorrect facts . A conviction was not made . For this reason , all reproaches are invalid .
